issue.title: just check fails at lint (ruff) F601: duplicate sase_finalizer key in telemetry catalog
issue.description:
## CI failure

- **Node:** `src/sase/telemetry/catalog.py`

`just check` fails at `lint (ruff)` with F601 (`Dictionary key literal "sase_finalizer" repeated`) on HEAD `f355faa96`. This is a static duplicate dict key, so it fails on every tree that contains both insertions; it is not timing- or order-dependent.

Two closed-phase landings independently added the same catalog mapping:

- `980bedfea` (`sase-rr.1`) inserted `"sase_finalizer": "Finalizers"` into `_PREFIX_TO_SUBSYSTEM` and `"Finalizers"` into `SUBSYSTEM_ORDER`.
- `f4fde13df` (`sase-ru.5`) inserted the same key and the same `SUBSYSTEM_ORDER` label again at the end of each collection.

Python keeps the last dict entry, and both values are identical, so runtime grouping is unchanged. Ruff F601 has no autofix. This project sets `commit_hooks.before: just fix`, and `just fix` runs `ruff check --fix src/ tests/`, so every `sase stitch create` fails until the duplicate key is removed.

`SUBSYSTEM_ORDER` also lists `"Finalizers"` twice (not an F601, but the same double-insert). Delete the later copies from `f4fde13df` and keep the `sase-rr.1` placement.

### Repro

```bash
.venv/bin/ruff check src/sase/telemetry/catalog.py
```

payload.entry: The duplicate sase_finalizer catalog key and duplicate SUBSYSTEM_ORDER Finalizers label were removed in this workspace so just check / just fix can proceed for resume-commit repository attribution. The surviving entries are the sase-rr.1 placement. Once that tree lands, this bead can close without further code change.
